correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly constructs the central graph dichotomy, solves the two ordered bilinear equations with determinant 1-lambda^2 nonzero in all characteristics, and counts each pair (U,T) and subdirect W by intersection kernels and an induced isomorphism. Each central-free W has q^dim W distinct graph lifts, and central-containing subalgebras are uniquely preimages of quotient subspaces. Exhaustive independent RREF checks over F4, F5, and F7 agree coefficientwise. Boundary lambda=plus/minus one is explicitly excluded; finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
